required_attestation_fields.execution_source_sha256: SHA-256 of THIS execution source's bytes (write-time binding)

positive_chain_property: A plain editable JSON that merely says {'released': true} CANNOT satisfy the gate: the attestation must bind BOTH this source's bytes AND the successful smoke artifact's bytes (which are themselves write-once).  Science is released ONLY after a successful v1.14 smoke PLUS this post-smoke release adjudication.
note: The attestation is INTENTIONALLY ABSENT at v1.14 freeze: it may only be written by a POST-SMOKE RELEASE ADJUDICATION after a successful v1.14 smoke.
